summary.intent: Finish ADR 0027 part 2 (exports in the canonical JSON, PR #420) and then audit caliper for over-engineering and non-idiomatic Rust, using a pattern list the user brought from a Callisto session.
summary.outcome: PR #420 was written up and a new trail (#307) was filed for the anonymous-default extractor bug. The audit's top findings were spot-checked against main, and a batch A cleanup (scripts, recordings, timing bounds, a duplicate test) was dispatched with no published surface touched. The public-API deletions are waiting on the user.

repo: ADR 0027 part 2 raised SCHEMA_VERSION from 6 to 7. The version pin and a 'reads 7, rejects 6' test now live in vite-plugin, storybook, oracle and Python, and UNIVERSE_VERSION is 3 so the weekly won't compare numbers across the change.
TOON and RDT carry no component identity, so they get no `exports` field.
The session index (`session_index_to_json`, `ComponentLocation`, napi `SessionIndex`) had to carry `exports` too, or the addon would get `undefined` from the real binding.

Some matching must stay name-based: RDT/react-docgen dump matching, a person's `list`, the weekly recall pairing, `agent_eval.py` and the vite-plugin `docgen-info.ts`. Re-exports and barrels are not in `exports`, so the addon keeps a barrel fallback by name.

`packages/storybook/src/exports.ts` keeps `wrappedDefaultOf` because the extractor records no export for call-wrapped defaults such as `export default React.forwardRef(X) as T` or `memo(forwardRef(Card))`.

Extractor bug from part 1: an anonymous default export beside `export const E = forwardRef(...)` in E.tsx is named after the file stem and its exports come out `[E, default]`. `keyOfExport` returns `undefined` for two candidates rather than guessing.

The audit found public-but-unused surface in the published core crate: the canonical-JSON `Deserialize`/`from_tagged_value` read side (only tests call it) and `DocgenPlugin`/`PluginRegistry` (no production implementor). Deleting either needs a core minor changeset.
`exclude` is documented as 'Glob patterns' (storybook README:34) but implemented as substring `contains` (`discover.rs:149`), a docs-versus-behavior bug.
The nine semantic replay recordings total about 4.4 MB pretty-printed, and compacting them to one call per line would save roughly 47%.

The semantic stack parts (dependency-tracked memo, per-snapshot parts cache, probe file, stale-file stamps, answer cache) are each backed by a test or gate that fails without it, so they are not over-engineering.

code.finding: Hand-written Value parser for PropType (about 263 lines) with no production caller. It swallows errors with `unwrap_or("")` and maps unknown kinds or reasons to `DepthExceeded`.
`Deserialize for ExtractionOutput` plus `expand` (about 115 lines), used only by tests.
The 203-line plugin module has 4 hook calls (`revision.rs:291,384,660`, `lazy.rs:649`) that run an always-empty registry.

`WireReason` is one of four places that write the nine `OpaqueReason` names (with `KINDS` at :1676, `kind()` at :1690 and the parse arms at :1473-1487). `#[serde(tag="type")]` on the enum could replace two of them.
`exclude` is implemented as substring `contains` although documented as glob patterns.
360 lines of source-text scanning with a hand-rolled grouped-`use` parser and three tests of the tester. `.clippy.toml` exists, so `disallowed-types` could cover the HashMap rule.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority. The assistant spot-checked the audit's claims against a freshly fetched main before relaying them, and the audit's base had gone stale (main had moved to 0a0da81e after #419 merged).
The pattern-audit prompt from the Callisto session was adapted to caliper by adding a ledger of the moving parts added in the ADR 0026 work and noting which S7 deletions would make findings moot.
Cleanups were split by risk: batch A touches no published surface and proceeds, while public-API deletions (plugin system, JSON read side, addon and napi options) wait for the user's decision.
The cleanup worker re-verifies each audit item on current main and drops any it can't prove, and it does not poll CI.
The audit sandbox blocked `git fetch`, so the audit worker ran only rg, wc, jq and file reads, with no builds, tests or clippy.

friction: The audit sandbox blocked `git fetch`, so findings were based on a possibly stale local origin/main and had to be re-verified.

The audit ran no builds, tests or clippy, so several claims remain unverified: the restart-policy dead code, the 19 timing asserts, the answer-cache hash redundancy, `reverse_queries` not being exercised in CI, `printed.rs` being replaceable by `oxc_parser`, and whether `cargo semver` would flag the deletions.
`weekly.py --oracle` was not run for #420, and `just test-integration` ran only in the main worktree, not the clean room.
PR #420 checks were still pending (15) when the PR body was written, and the Entire Gates check waits on the user.
Several PRs (#418, #419, #420, #396) and ADR 0027 are waiting on the user, which stalls dependent work such as the oracle comparator trail #303 and the #307 fix.
open_items: Trail #307: give each component mapping its own identity (Local(name) or Inline(span_start)), record exports for call-wrapped defaults, and delete `wrappedDefaultOf` if it becomes redundant. It starts after #420 merges.
Trail #303 (oracle comparator) is held until #420 merges because both edit the same oracle files.

Update ADR 0027: the decision text says `Menu.Item` but the recorded path is `default.Item`. Also note that re-exports and barrels aren't in `exports` and that some call-wrapped defaults are missed (mostly covered by #418, the last two not yet).
Run `weekly.py --oracle` once after the batch merges to see the new numbers.

User decisions needed: delete the plugin system (recommended as its own core-minor PR), delete the JSON read side (only after confirming no external consumers), and the addon/napi surface (`warmUp`, `fillAfter`, `session_stats`, `JsLazyStats`).
Fix or document the `exclude` glob-vs-substring mismatch, probably as a trail item.

Batch A (`chore/lean-batch-a`) is in progress: delete the `checker_modes*` and `collapse_relevance*` scripts, compact the recordings, drop redundant timing bounds, remove the duplicate Send/Sync test.

Deferred audit items: dead `Supervisor` restart code, answer-cache content hash, debug-only instrumentation (`Rpc.calls`, `REQUESTS`, `memo_stats`), `reverse_queries` (add to the checker lane or delete), `SCHEMA_VERSION` consolidation into one file, `OpaqueReason` serde derive, `architecture.rs` simplification, `caliperNorm(t: any)` typing.
The first-answer and watch budget decision that gates S7 and S8 is still open, as are the reviews of #418, #419, #420, #396 and ADR 0027.
